title: Computer vision, graphics & assistive technology
place: University of Siegen · PhD with Volker Blanz
blurb: Example-based rendering, procedural cities, and a doctoral thesis on making images audible for blind users — modular computer-vision sonification that became the PictureSensation app.

title: Computational biology
place: Carnegie Institution for Science, Stanford · Rhee lab
blurb: Postdoc on gene regulation and plant metabolism: Markov-random-field refinement of gene regulatory networks (GRACE), METACLUSTER for metabolic gene clusters, and the Plant Metabolic Network enzyme/pathway pipeline.

title: Machine learning in manufacturing
blurb: Co-developed the Integrated System Solution approach and the ML offering: OPC UA retrofits for press and milling machines, tool-wear prediction from low-cost sensors, and model monitoring with deep feature embeddings.

title: Gene regulation, continued
place: with Thomas Hartwig (HHU Düsseldorf / MPIPZ Cologne) · EducatedGuess.ai
blurb: A thread that never stopped: allele-specific ChIP-seq, the maize pan-cistrome and binding QTL (Nature Genetics 2025), METACLUSTERplus, and now sequence models that predict, explain and design TF-binding variation.

title: AI engineering & geometric deep learning
blurb: Topological deep learning (TopoBench, the ICML TDL challenges, curvature-based lifting against over-squashing), GraphRAG with plugin ontologies, memory-aware software agents, and MCP in manufacturing.
